design_requirements.name: nominal thrust or alternate sizing basis
design_requirements.selection_reason: Team-approved sizing basis required; no value assumed.

design_requirements.name: ambient/back pressure design condition
design_requirements.selection_reason: Required to interpret thrust and nozzle design condition.

design_requirements.name: burn duration and duty cycle
design_requirements.selection_reason: Required for thermal and supply review even if not a geometry solver input.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: oxidizer and fuel definitions with inlet states
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: Exact propellant identity and state required.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: chamber pressure
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: Must come from approved candidate comparison and supply feasibility.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: mixture ratio or component mass fractions
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: Must come from approved performance/stability trade study.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: nozzle inlet and exit conditions or expansion definition
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: RPA Nozzle Flow Model input; design condition not yet approved.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: sizing control selection
rpa_direct_inputs.unit: nominal thrust, mass flow, or throat diameter
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: RPA documents at least one sizing parameter; selection is a team decision.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: nozzle shape selection
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: RPA Nozzle Flow Model selection; no default adopted.

rpa_geometry_inputs.name: contraction angle and contraction radii ratios
rpa_geometry_inputs.selection_reason: Geometry assumptions require literature or approved design basis.

rpa_geometry_inputs.name: bell contour parameters or conical half-angle
rpa_geometry_inputs.selection_reason: Nozzle contour assumptions require an approved source.

rpa_computed_outputs.name: calculated thrust-chamber and nozzle size report

rpa_export_capabilities.name: size and geometry results Save As ASCII
rpa_export_capabilities.notes: Documented by the RPA 2.3 user manual; actual SPACE Y export not executed.

rpa_export_capabilities.name: thrust-chamber contour export to DXF
rpa_export_capabilities.notes: Standard-edition manual documents units and dimension/contour options; local license/UI execution still needs confirmation.

separately_decided_design_items.name: injector element, manifold and face design
separately_decided_design_items.selection_reason: Not determined by the RPA chamber/nozzle sizing output.

separately_decided_design_items.name: regenerative channel count, width, height, rib and routing
wall thickness, material, joints, seals and ports

change_triggers: approved thrust, pressure, mixture ratio, ambient condition or duration changes
supply feasibility or stability evidence changes
nozzle shape, characteristic length or contraction geometry changes
new M0, structural or combustion-stability evidence
